channel.title: Articles | Goutham S
channel.description: Writing on distributed systems, databases, and building for the web.

item.title: Evolution of AI: A Walk Up the AI Ladder from Regression to Transformers
item.description: AI did not evolve because researchers got bored. Each era exists because the one before it hit a wall. A walk up the ladder from linear regression to transformers, tracing what broke at every rung and what fixed it.

item.title: Partitioned Tables in MySQL: The Good, The Bad, and The Practical Workarounds
item.description: A practical look at MySQL table partitioning: what it actually buys you, the constraints nobody warns you about, and the workarounds that keep it usable in real systems.

item.title: Vector Databases: A Developer's Guide to Semantic Search, Recommendations, and RAG
item.description: A developer's guide to vector databases: what they solve, how they are built, the options worth knowing, and the design trade-offs that decide whether your semantic search actually works.
